description: Inactive thin Codex projection candidate for demand-driven task delivery, pre-response enrollment capture, and bounded carrier lifecycle decisions.

interface.shortDescription: Delivers goals with demand-driven routing and continuity
interface.longDescription: An inactive thin reference-host projection candidate with one task-facing Skill, one bounded carrier Hook, and one pre-response enrollment-capture Hook. The enrollment Hook reads the submitted prompt only in memory, stores and emits keyed commitments rather than raw prompt or session identity, deletes derived session state at SessionEnd, executes no task-repository code, and does not claim complete tool or user-visible-output interception. Both Hooks remain fail-closed until a trusted runtime, exact Hook trust, an authorized private cohort key, and a future profile binding are materialized.
defaultPrompt: Tell me the result you want. I will own the capability route, continuity, verification, and cleanup.
